title: 第9章 药堂学徒第10章 易筋
slug: 有熟练度面板的我学什么都快
content_zh:
第二日，清晨，冬日的初升阳光带着些许寒意，弥漫在周围。
林潜穿着薄衫打开房门，寒冷侵袭而来，远处的杂役穿着厚厚的棉衣在干活。
林潜并没有感觉到冷。
他发现突破练皮的另一个好处--耐寒。
随着他完成练皮后，不仅提高了防御，还增强了对温度的忍耐力。
......
炼药堂。
林潜正从里面快步出来，刚刚他花了两百个铜板买了一份壮体汤，现准备回去继续修炼。
还差20%的熟练度，通臂拳就到三阶了，林潜很是期待。
林潜开始过起了比前世还规律的生活，早起早睡。
虽然枯燥但并不乏味，看着熟练度一点一点的上涨，反而动力十足。
当然林潜也不是一直宅在院里或者树林中修炼，休息的时候会去学堂藏书室看书增长见识。
有时候林潜也会去演武场转转，听听其他师兄们讲的八卦，顺便混个脸熟。
以免以后一起做任务，其他弟子都不知道他这号人。
出去转悠还是有好处的。
林潜从其他弟子交谈中，了解到不少信息。
比如:给富商当护卫，富商打赏的银子不用上交宗门；突破到锻骨境界就能成为内门弟子；某某师兄表白师姐被拒绝。
......
炼药堂大厅。
坐在上座的刘堂主看着刘成，气打不一处来。

“我交代你的事，办得怎么样了？”
“叔叔，我还在筛选中，只是一时没有找到合适的人选。”
刘成一脸认真的说道。
刘成表情看起来既认真又带着点疲惫，不知道的还以刘成一直在尽心尽力办事。
“啪。”
刘堂主手掌重重的拍在桌上。
“装，你给我继续装，别以为我不知道你这几天在干嘛。”
刘成脸色立马变了，赔笑道：“叔叔，我错了，明明我是记得的，结果我修炼得太入神，给忘了。”
“不过，叔叔你不要担心，不是还有两天时间嘛，这两天我什么都不修炼了，就专门处理这件事，一定能完成。”
刘成小心翼翼的看着叔叔。
“又是在研究你那捡来的无名功法？你那功法我也看了，甚至还拿给了掌门看了，写得倒是玄奥，可是修炼起来，没什么变化，你还是放弃吧。”
刘堂主语气变缓，再次劝说道。
“肯定是你们修炼方法不对，只要找对方法，肯定可以修炼成功。”
刘成一脸的不服气，虽然他自己没练出个什么来，但他总觉得这个功法不简单。
这个功法是刘成在三首山寻药时，突然下起大雨，在山中寻找避雨之地时，发现了一个隐藏密室。
密室里躺着一个骷髅，骨头洁白如玉，隐隐散发着光芒，看样子死去了很久。
content_en:
On the second day, in the early morning, the rising sunshine of winter filled the surroundings with a bit of chill.
Lin Qian opened the door wearing a thin shirt, and the cold came. In the distance, a handyman wearing a thick cotton coat was working.
Lin Qian didn't feel cold.
He discovered another benefit of breakthrough skin training-cold resistance.
After he completed the skin training, he not only improved his defense, but also enhanced his tolerance to temperature.
...
Medicine refining hall.
Lin Qian was hurrying out of it. He had just spent two hundred coppers to buy a body-building soup, and now he was going back to continue practicing.
There is still 20% proficiency left, and the Tongjiquan has reached the third level. Lin Qian is looking forward to it.
Lin Qian began to live a more regular life than in his previous life, getting up early and going to bed early.
Although it is boring, it is not boring. Watching the proficiency increase bit by bit, it is full of motivation.
Of course, Lin Qian did not always practice in the courtyard or in the woods. During his breaks, he would go to the school library to read and gain knowledge.
Sometimes Lin Qian would also go to the martial arts arena, listen to the gossips told by other senior brothers, and become familiar with them by the way.
In order to avoid doing tasks together in the future, other disciples will not know his identity.
There are benefits to being out and about.
Lin Qian learned a lot of information from the conversations with other disciples.
For example: working as a guard for a wealthy businessman, the money rewarded by the wealthy businessman does not need to be handed over to the sect; breaking through to the bone forging realm can become an inner disciple; a certain senior brother confessed to his senior sister but was rejected.
...
The lobby of the Medicine Refining Hall.
Hall Master Liu, who was sitting in the upper seat, looked at Liu Cheng and was furious.
"How did you go about the things I asked you to do?"
"Uncle, I'm still in the process of screening, but I haven't found a suitable candidate for the moment."
Liu Cheng said seriously.
Liu Cheng's expression looked serious and a little tired, but he didn't know that Liu Cheng had been doing his best.
"Crack."
Hall Master Liu slapped his palm heavily on the table.
"Pretend, keep pretending, don't think I don't know what you've been doing these days."
Liu Cheng's expression immediately changed, and he said with an apologetic smile: "Uncle, I was wrong. I obviously remembered it, but I was so absorbed in practicing that I forgot about it."
"But uncle, don't worry, there are still two days left. I won't be practicing anything in these two days. I will just deal with this matter. I will definitely complete it."
Liu Cheng looked at his uncle carefully.
"Are you studying the unknown technique you picked up again? I have also read your technique, and even showed it to the leader. It is quite mysterious, but after practicing it, there is no change, so you should give up."
Hall Master Liu's tone softened and he persuaded again.
"Your cultivation method must be wrong. As long as you find the right method, you will definitely be able to cultivate successfully."
Liu Cheng looked unconvinced. Although he had not practiced anything, he always felt that this technique was not simple.
This technique was developed when Liu Cheng was looking for medicine in Sanshou Mountain. It suddenly started raining heavily. When he was looking for a shelter from the rain in the mountain, he discovered a hidden secret room.
There was a skeleton lying in the secret room. The bones were as white as jade and glowed faintly. It looked like it had been dead for a long time.
